entry.name: freqshift~
entry.description: freqshift~ is a time-domain frequency shifter (also known as a single-sideband ring modulator).

arguments.description: A numerical argument will be used as the frequency shift in Hertz. The default is zero.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clears sample memory (in case the filter is blown up).

messages.name: float
messages.description: In right inlet: a float in the right inlet will be used as a frequency amount in Hertz by which the left input signal will be shifted.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In right inlet: Converted to. A number value in the right inlet will be used as a frequency amount in Hertz by which the left input signal will be shifted.

messages.name: resetphase
messages.description: Resets the phase of the two cycles that modulate the sidebands of the incoming signal.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: The signal present at the left inlet is frequency-shifted by the argument or value given in the right inlet.In right inlet: a signal in the right inlet will be used as a frequency amount in Hertz by which the left input signal will be shifted.
